billing_price_promotion_check.name: billing_price_promotion_check
billing_price_promotion_check.value: (promotion_price_minor is null and promotion_starts_at is null and promotion_ends_at is null) or (promotion_price_minor is not null and promotion_starts_at is not null and promotion_ends_at is not null and promotion_price_minor > 0 and promotion_price_minor < price_minor and promotion_starts_at < promotion_ends_at)

credit_debt_remaining_check.name: credit_debt_remaining_check
credit_debt_remaining_check.value: remaining >= 0 and remaining <= amount and amount > 0

domain_claim_method_check.name: domain_claim_method_check
domain_claim_method_check.value: method is null or method in ('dns_txt', 'well_known')

kyc_record_files_idx.name: kyc_record_files_idx
kyc_record_files_idx.where: files_deleted_at is null and (document_blob is not null or selfie_blob is not null)

kyc_record_document_kind_check.name: kyc_record_document_kind_check
kyc_record_document_kind_check.value: document_kind is null or document_kind in ('passport', 'id', 'residence')

kyc_record_tax_form_check.name: kyc_record_tax_form_check
kyc_record_tax_form_check.value: tax_form is null or tax_form in ('W-8BEN', 'W-9')

kyc_record_submission_check.name: kyc_record_submission_check
kyc_record_submission_check.value: status = 'reset' or (legal_name is not null and country is not null and document_kind is not null and document_last4 is not null and document_expires is not null and tax_form is not null and tax_declared_at is not null and consent_at is not null)

message_no_answer_reason_check.name: message_no_answer_reason_check
message_no_answer_reason_check.value: no_answer_reason is null or no_answer_reason in ('no_sources', 'out_of_scope')

model_call_audience_check.name: model_call_audience_check
model_call_audience_check.value: audience is null or audience in ('free', 'plan')

payout_paid_check.name: payout_paid_check
payout_paid_check.value: (status = 'paid') = (paid_cents is not null and transfer_id is not null)

payout_paid_cents_check.name: payout_paid_cents_check
payout_paid_cents_check.value: paid_cents is null or (paid_cents > 0 and paid_cents::bigint * 100 <= credits)

payout_fee_check.name: payout_fee_check
payout_fee_check.value: fee_credits is null or (fee_credits >= 0 and fee_credits = credits - paid_cents::bigint * 100)

ree_public_idx.name: ree_public_idx
ree_public_idx.where: is_public and moderated_at is null and deleted_at is null

ree_moderated_private_check.name: ree_moderated_private_check
ree_moderated_private_check.value: moderated_at is null or not is_public

ree_video_generated_check.name: ree_video_generated_check
ree_video_generated_check.value: not generated or scenes is not null
